# Inactive reconstructed CJK companion

This is new source after the 2026-10-06 workspace reset. It is not the old reviewed package or a new customer release. Version `0.9.4+viola.cjk.2` distinguishes the reconstruction from the lost `.1` wheel. No registry publication, profile activation or installed/native qualification is implied.

The four required official Misaki modules, `ja_words.txt`, Apache license and three inherited MIT notices were recovered from authenticated Git objects and match the previously recorded hashes. The decimal preparer was reconstructed from retained source text and matches its original hash. The authored bridge, dispatcher and runtime forwarding are new source and require fresh tests/review.

The old Japanese dictionary receipt was lost. A fresh official unidic-py 3.1.0+2021-08-31 candidate now supplies eighteen exact file identities, including its unchanged notices. The new factory hashes these files in 1 MiB chunks before imports, captures the canonical directory, supplies an explicit neutral configuration and the verified 29-field schema, and checks the dictionary actually selected. It never probes an ambient dictionary. This source/asset qualification does not establish native Japanese initialization, Windows loading or old per-file equality. Mandarin and English dependencies also need their deleted environments restored before real G2P replay. No original native/audio receipt is reused as current proof.

These eight `misaki` payloads are additions to the existing `viola-misaki-en` files in one physical installed package directory. This distribution owns no `misaki/__init__.py`, `misaki/data/__init__.py`, English module or lexicon. Separate source roots do not automatically merge with the English regular package. Packaging must verify the combined physical layout and retain the English bytes exactly.

The declared dependency versions are the same previously investigated versions; this reconstruction does not install them or assert complete transitive license/native-wheel qualification. Original Apache and MIT notices are retained. The existing Fugashi/MeCab, UniDic and other dependency attribution/terms remain separate final bundle obligations. No historical fork lineage or new license election is inferred.

All eight language families and 54 voice arrays remain required. General Italian/Hindi, inactive Romance integration, acoustic quality, frozen/native compatibility, signed inclusion and installed proof stay open. Caller-selected voice identity and application defaults remain unchanged.
